items.title: Oppo Enco X4 TWS earbuds set for September 22 global launch with AI translation and Dynaudio tuning
items.summary: Oppo's flagship Enco X4 earbuds debut globally on September 22 with AI-powered real-time two-way translation, a coaxial dual-driver system co-developed with Dynaudio, a dual DAC, 4K-class lossless transmission (up to 400 percent faster than the previous generation) and a 6nm AI noise-cancellation chip. Human-voice noise reduction is claimed to improve by up to 250 percent.

items.title: TOZO launches NC9 Pro earbuds with 1.47-inch smart touchscreen case and LDAC Hi-Res audio
items.summary: TOZO's NC9 Pro introduces a 1.47-inch smart touchscreen charging case that doubles as a control center, alongside LDAC and Hi-Res Audio Wireless, advanced ANC, AI translation and a 10mm SDLC dynamic driver. The earbuds add EarTune hearing optimization, Bluetooth 6.0 multipoint, IPX8 water resistance and a low-latency gaming mode, available from September 15.

items.title: Audeze Maxwell 2 ANC brings active noise cancellation to a planar magnetic gaming headphone
items.summary: Audeze launched the Maxwell 2 ANC, which it calls the world's first full-range planar magnetic headphone with active noise cancellation. The hybrid ANC system is engineered to preserve the same frequency response whether ANC is on or off, retaining the 90mm planar drivers, SLAM bass technology and FILTER AI microphone noise removal. The PlayStation version is priced at $429 and the Xbox version at $449.

items.title: Anker enters the OTC hearing aid market with AI-powered RIC Hearing Aids Pro at IFA 2026
items.summary: Anker unveiled its first over-the-counter hearing aids at IFA 2026, the RIC Hearing Aids Pro built on the company's THUS AI chip running 7.2 billion operations per second with four beam-forming microphones to isolate speech in noisy places. The self-fitting devices include an onboard hearing test and a fast-charging case, targeting a US launch in early 2027 after two major OTC makers wound down operations.

items.title: Sennheiser MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 add Dolby Atmos head tracking and user-replaceable batteries
items.summary: Sennheiser's flagship earbuds gain Bluetooth 6.0, aptX Lossless up to 24-bit/96kHz, upgraded adaptive hybrid ANC and Dolby Atmos-optimized head tracking. Unusually for true wireless, both the earbuds and the charging case use user-replaceable batteries serviced with a small screwdriver, with up to 12 hours per charge and 40 hours total. Shipping began September 3 at $299.95.

items.title: Hisense enters portable Bluetooth speakers with FlexBoom, WeBoom and VoyageBoom outdoor lineup
items.summary: Hisense launched its first outdoor portable Bluetooth speakers - FlexBoom, WeBoom and VoyageBoom - in the US, expanding the TV maker into portable audio against established players JBL and Ultimate Ears. First shown at CES 2026, the rugged lineup marks a new front in the competitive Bluetooth speaker market.

items.title: JBL takes on Sonos with new multi-room Cove speakers
items.summary: JBL introduced the Cove series of connected speakers that can run independently, as a stereo pair, or linked into a multi-room sound system. The lineup marks the portable and party-speaker specialist's formal move into whole-home, app-controlled audio to challenge Sonos, with wi-fi enabled home models joining its Bluetooth range.

items.title: DPA and Wisycom deliver on Lorde's 'Ultrasound' world tour
items.summary: FOH engineer Philip J. Harvey employed a DPA d:facto 4018VL capsule for Lorde while monitor engineer Keven Glendinning used Wisycom MPR50 beltpacks and MTK transmitters on the 'Ultrasound' world tour, highlighting the growing role of premium microphone and RF wireless systems in large-scale live productions.

items.title: Ceva launches Microsoft-certified RealSpace Elevate spatial audio software for PC gaming headsets
items.summary: Ceva introduced RealSpace Elevate for Windows, a Microsoft-certified, licensable Windows Audio Processing Object (APO) that lets gaming headset and PC OEMs deliver customizable branded spatial audio without building a proprietary stack. It supports 7.1 multichannel rendering with pinpoint localization and game-focused presets that highlight footsteps and gunshots.

items.title: Voicemod's pocket-friendly device brings real-time voice changing to your phone
items.summary: Voicemod announced a new mobile device that extends its real-time voice-changing Key dongle to phones, letting users apply sound effects and a soundboard on the go. The hardware builds on the console-focused Voicemod Key launched in late 2024 and broadens the company's reach into mobile creators.

items.title: Bose's next open earbuds have more bass, more volume, and more battery life
items.summary: Bose unveiled the second-generation Ultra Open Earbuds with a more powerful bass driver, higher maximum volume and longer battery life, refining its open-ear, hear-through design for runners and audiophiles who want ambient awareness without isolating from the world.

items.title: A little-known audio company is trying to get Samsung, Apple, and Google devices banned in the US
items.summary: An audio patent holder filed a complaint that could lead US regulators to block imports of Samsung, Apple and Google devices, alleging infringement in wireless audio and voice technology - a move that could ripple across the smartphone and earbud market if granted.

items.title: Winamp will be reborn in 2027 to take on streaming
items.summary: Winamp announced it will return in 2027 through a partnership with Deezer, repositioning the iconic music player as a streaming-era service in a bid to challenge Spotify and Apple Music after years of dormancy.

items.title: Samsung's open-ear Galaxy Buds On leak with clip design, 'Auto Volume,' gestures
items.summary: Leaked renders show Samsung's open-ear Galaxy Buds On with a clip-on design, 'Auto Volume' adaptive loudness and gesture controls, signaling Samsung's entry into the open-ear TWS category popularized by Bose.

items.title: Nothing reportedly launching 'Headphone (1) Pro' later this month for $399
items.summary: Nothing is reportedly preparing a 'Headphone (1) Pro' over-ear model priced at $399, expanding its audio lineup beyond the Headphone (1) and Ear (1) into the premium headphone segment.

items.title: Sony's new party speakers have more bass, more LEDs, and more connectivity
items.summary: Sony expanded its ULT Power Sound line with new party speakers adding more bass, LED lighting and expanded connectivity including XLR inputs for DJs and live performers.

items.title: Anker put a display on the case of its new sleepbuds
items.summary: Anker added a small display to the charging case of its new Sleepbuds 4 Pro, which play ambient sound to help users fall asleep and now show battery and playback status at a glance.

items.title: Ikea supersized its cheap Bluetooth speaker and added an optical input
items.summary: Ikea supersized its affordable Badkruka Bluetooth speaker and added an optical input, extending its budget home audio range with a larger cabinet and wired connectivity.
